verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents and ships an official MCP server that exposes collections, requests, environments, and teams to an agent, and a hands-on probe confirms the MCP handshake succeeds via npx. This is strong first-party and hands-on evidence of the exact capability described. missing for 10: independent (non-vendor-run) third-party review of the MCP server in real agent workflows beyond the probe handshake.
